closed_standard: A user-facing milestone is CLOSED only when its real Michael, Lianne, or employee workflow works end-to-end in Twelve Hats Beta with required authority, history, and audit evidence, or its explicit non-user-facing final acceptance standard is met.

controller_policy.LaptopE: Filter owning_factory=LAPTOP; assign the highest-priority dependency-safe item to Laptop-A, Laptop-B, or Phone; keep post-Production intelligence out of P0 release unless it becomes a concrete dependency.
controller_policy.OM1E: Read all milestones; own protected integration, schema, release, security, platform, acceptance ledger, and global dependency arbitration.
controller_policy.OM1_WORKERS: Filter owning_factory=OM1 and the lane identity; pull the highest-priority dependency-safe item; human/provider-gated items do not prevent pulling another independent item.
controller_policy.OM2E: Filter owning_factory=OM2; assign the highest-priority dependency-safe item to OM2-A, OM2-B, or OM2-C; integrate worker output into the cumulative Operations head.
controller_policy.idle_rule: NO_DEPENDENCY_SAFE_ITEM is the only valid idle result and must be accompanied by recorded human, provider, legal, dependency, or safety gates.
controller_policy.new_prerequisite: Add a stable child item or dependency edge, record evidence, revalidate the acyclic graph, then select another admissible item.
controller_policy.state_update: Update the canonical file in the same protected PR as material evidence. Integration and deployment advance their own fields but never imply CLOSED.
